data.body:
OPERATOR DECISION ON AC3 — resolved as option (a): accept the literal reading plus the deterministic
regression test. Recorded before acting on it.

The criterion as written asks for "a real plan-review run [that] emits no contract violation and
findings retain their verified severity rather than degrading to INDETERMINATE". The live run cited
in the previous comment meets that text: no contract violation, INDETERMINATE 0, and four findings
carrying real verified severities with populated verification blocks.

What that run does NOT do is execute the repaired branch — empty_outcomes was 0, so no empty batch was
synthesised. The branch a zero-finding run would reach is instead covered deterministically by
tests/unit/test_verify_empty_batch_contract.py (4 passed at this tree), which is AC2 and which fails
before the fix.

The operator has accepted that pairing: the live run evidences the non-regression, the unit test
evidences the repair. AC3 is NOT being reworded to fit the evidence — it is being accepted on its own
text, with the coverage gap named rather than hidden. A future organic zero-finding run would be
welcome confirmation but is not a precondition for closing.

Rejected alternatives, for the record: narrowing AC3 to require a zero-finding run would leave the
ticket open on an event that cannot be scheduled (43 of 3908 historical runs, roughly 1%); spending
repeated full-price review runs to force one was judged not worth the cost against a deterministic
proof that already exists.
